description: Shows where a press release is: draft, waiting for a person to check it, scheduled or live, with the live link once it is published. Only when the user asks about a release later. Not needed after create_release or publish_release, whose answers already say this. Returns the status (draft, review, scheduled, live, rejected or removed), the preview or live link, and why it waits when a person checks it.
name: get_release_status
title: Check a release
